config.system: Solve the requested multiple-choice exam questions. Give a short reason of at most 15 words for each question, then the selected OPTION NUMBER (not the answer text or computed value). Return JSON with reasons and answers maps keyed by the requested question numbers. Null is only for unreadable/missing input. Choose the best option even when uncertain. Do not copy the passage.
